title: dembrane v3: overview
description: Is dembrane v3 up, where does it hurt, is it scaling. Log based panels read at most 13 hours.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.definition: query_result(sort_desc(3 * group by (namespace) (kube_pod_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__"}) or 2 * group by (namespace) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"dembrane-web-.*"}) or label_replace(vector(1), "namespace", "__NAMESPACE__", "", "")))

query.query: query_result(sort_desc(3 * group by (namespace) (kube_pod_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__"}) or 2 * group by (namespace) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"dembrane-web-.*"}) or label_replace(vector(1), "namespace", "__NAMESPACE__", "", "")))

panels.title: Public checks
panels.description: HTTP checks of the public addresses, every 30 s. UP means the last check got a 2xx answer.

targets.expr: min by (svc) (probe_success{job="blackbox_http"})

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Share of requests through the ingress that got a 5xx answer in the last 5 minutes. Yellow from 5 %, red from 20 %: the alert thresholds.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (controller_pod, ingress, host, status, method, path) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace="$namespace", status=~"5.."}[5m]))) or vector(0)) / sum(max by (controller_pod, ingress, host, status, method, path) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace="$namespace"}[5m])))

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95 % of requests through the ingress in the last 5 minutes finished within this time. Yellow from 1 s, red from 3 s: the alert thresholds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max by (controller_pod, ingress, host, status, method, path, le) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Pods the five deployments want and do not have ready. Red from 1: the alert threshold. A rollout or a scale-up shows here until the new pods are ready.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"} - kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, 0))

panels.title: Restarts (1 h)
panels.description: Container restarts in this namespace in the last hour.

targets.expr: sum(round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace"}[1h])))

panels.title: OOM kills (1 h)
panels.description: Restarts in the last hour of containers that were killed for exceeding their memory limit. Red from 1: the alert threshold.

targets.expr: sum(round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace"}[1h])) * on (namespace, pod, container) kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="$namespace", reason="OOMKilled"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests per second by host
panels.description: Requests through the ingress, per public host. A host is named by its first part.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (host) (max by (controller_pod, ingress, host, status, method, path) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))), "site", "$1", "host", "([^.]+).*")

panels.title: Requests per second by status class
panels.description: The same requests, stacked by the first digit of the status code.

targets.expr: sum by (class) (label_replace(max by (controller_pod, ingress, host, status, method, path) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])), "class", "$1", "status", "(.).."))

panels.title: p95 latency by host
panels.description: 95 % of requests to each host finished within this time, over 5 minutes. Dashed lines at 1 s and 3 s: the alert thresholds.

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, le) (max by (controller_pod, ingress, host, status, method, path, le) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace"}[5m])))), "site", "$1", "host", "([^.]+).*")

panels.title: Workloads
panels.description: One row per deployment, now. Pods / max turns yellow at 100 %: the autoscaler cannot add more. CPU / request turns yellow from 90 % and Memory / limit from 90 % (alert thresholds), red at the limit. HPA min and max read none where a deployment has a fixed number of pods.

targets.expr: sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)"))

clamp_min(sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)")) - sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)")), 0)

max by (workload) (label_replace(kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_min_replicas{namespace="$namespace", horizontalpodautoscaler=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "horizontalpodautoscaler", "dembrane-web-(.*)")) or on (workload) (sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)")) * 0)

max by (workload) (label_replace(kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas{namespace="$namespace", horizontalpodautoscaler=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "horizontalpodautoscaler", "dembrane-web-(.*)")) or on (workload) (sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)")) * 0)

sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)")) / max by (workload) (label_replace(kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas{namespace="$namespace", horizontalpodautoscaler=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "horizontalpodautoscaler", "dembrane-web-(.*)"))

sum by (workload) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", pod=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"}[5m]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*")) / sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", resource="cpu", pod=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"))

sum by (workload) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", pod=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"}[5m]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*")) / sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="cpu", pod=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"))

sum by (workload) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!="", pod=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*")) / sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="memory", pod=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"))

sum by (workload) (label_replace(round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"}[1h])), "workload", "$1", "pod", "dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)-.*"))

panels.title: Ready pods by workload
panels.description: Ready pods, stacked. The dashed line is the most pods the autoscalers allow, counting a deployment without one at its fixed size.

targets.expr: sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)"))

sum(max by (workload) (label_replace(kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas{namespace="$namespace", horizontalpodautoscaler=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "horizontalpodautoscaler", "dembrane-web-(.*)")) or on (workload) sum by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="$namespace", deployment=~"dembrane-web-(api|worker|media|dashboard|portal)"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "dembrane-web-(.*)")))

panels.title: Worker jobs by state
panels.description: Jobs in the worker's queues (DBOS), summed over all queues, from the queue health line the worker logs every minute. Failed counts jobs that failed in the last 24 hours. Deferred jobs and each queue are on the worker and jobs dashboard.

targets.expr: sum(max by (name) (max_over_time({namespace="$namespace", component="worker"} |= "\"signal\":\"queue.depth\"" | json name="name", v="failed" | unwrap v [2m])))
sum(max by (name) (max_over_time({namespace="$namespace", component="worker"} |= "\"signal\":\"queue.depth\"" | json name="name", v="active" | unwrap v [2m])))
sum(max by (name) (max_over_time({namespace="$namespace", component="worker"} |= "\"signal\":\"queue.depth\"" | json name="name", v="ready" | unwrap v [2m])))

panels.title: Jobs finished per minute
panels.description: Jobs the worker finished per minute (5 minute average). A red line appears when attempts fail. Scheduled jobs keep this above zero while the worker is alive.

targets.expr: sum(rate({namespace="$namespace", component="worker"} |= "\"message\":\"job done\"" [5m])) * 60 or vector(0)
sum(rate({namespace="$namespace", component="worker"} |= "\"message\":\"job failed\"" [5m])) * 60

panels.title: Nodes ready
panels.description: Nodes that are ready, per node pool. The line shows the count over the selected period.

targets.expr: sum by (pool) (max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) * on (node) group_left (pool) group by (node, pool) (label_replace(label_replace(up{job="kubernetes-nodes-cadvisor"}, "node", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "pool", "$1", "doks_digitalocean_com_node_pool", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Node CPU use
panels.description: CPU in use on each node, one line per node. Dashed line at 80 %: the alert threshold.

targets.expr: (1 - avg by (address) (label_replace(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job="node-exporter"}[5m]), "address", "$1", "instance", "(.+):\\d+"))) * on (address) group_left (node) max by (address, node) (kube_node_status_addresses{type="InternalIP"})

panels.title: Node memory use
panels.description: Memory in use on each node, one line per node. Dashed line at 85 %: the alert threshold.

targets.expr: (1 - max by (address) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"}, "address", "$1", "instance", "(.+):\\d+")) / max by (address) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}, "address", "$1", "instance", "(.+):\\d+"))) * on (address) group_left (node) max by (address, node) (kube_node_status_addresses{type="InternalIP"})

panels.title: API routes, from the request log
API requests per minute by route (top 10)
panels.description: Requests the API answered, by route, from its request log (5 minute average).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route) (rate({namespace="$namespace", component="api"} |= "\"message\":\"request\"" | json route="route" [5m])) * 60)

panels.title: API 5xx answers per 5 min by route
panels.description: Requests the API answered with a 5xx status, by route. No data means there were none.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace", component="api"} |= "\"message\":\"request\"" |= "\"severity\":\"ERROR\"" | json route="route", status="httpRequest.status" | status >= 500 [$__interval]))

panels.title: API p95 latency by route (slowest 10)
panels.description: 95 % of the API's answers on each route finished within this time, over 5 minutes.

targets.expr: topk(10, quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="$namespace", component="api"} |= "\"message\":\"request\"" | json route="route", latency="httpRequest.latency" | unwrap duration_seconds(latency) | __error__="" [5m]) by (route))
